english.default: Without serving the True Guru, he suffers in terrible pain, and throughout the four ages, he wanders aimlessly.

translation.spanish: Sin servir al Verdadero Guru, uno se encuentra en inmenso dolor, y época tras época es desviado.

english.default: I am poor and meek, and throughout the ages, You are the Great Giver - please, grant me the understanding of the Shabad. ||1||

translation.spanish: Soy pobre y desvalido, Tú eres el Gran Dador a través de las épocas, por favor concédeme el entendimiento del Shabd. (1)

english.default: O Dear Beloved Lord, please show mercy to me.

translation.spanish: Conquistando el deseo y la dualidad me he inmergido en la Paz Celestial,

english.default: I have tasted the sublime essence of the Lord, and my soul has become immaculately pure; the Lord is the Destroyer of sins. ||2||
